> *"You cannot get through a single day without having an impact on the world around you. What you do makes a difference, and you have to decide what kind of difference you want to make."* — Jane Goodall

### About me

I am a biostatistician with a keen interest in unravelling complex population processes—particularly within the field of health—through mathematical and statistical modelling.

**Statistical Interests:**

- Stochastic Processes
- Bayesian Statistics
- Longitudinal Models
- Statistical Learning

**Areas of Application:**

- Epidemiology and Demography: Mortality, Migration, Health Inequities, Non-communicable Diseases (NCDs), Substance Use, Infectious Diseases, and Environmental Health

Also, I enjoy running 🏃‍♂️, swimming 🏊‍♂️, photography 📷, and philosophy 📚.
